name: vortex
description: VORTEX v6 agent messaging for Codex: tools vx_send and read-only vx_read (history and own DMs); optional wake of the bound chat through the app-server as tool output, passive context through hooks.

interface.longDescription: Receive addressed peer messages in the chat selected with `vx codex bind`, see unaddressed traffic as data-only hook context, send with vx_send, and catch up with the read-only vx_read without marking anything delivered.
